pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown contiguous regions display sharp, high-frequency edge angularity. The pixel-level geometry is characterized by complex, non-smooth perimeters with irregular, jagged projections into the surrounding light regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored pathways form an interconnected network with non-uniform pixel thickness. Junction nodes exhibit a multi-point convergence pattern where pathways widen. The network is continuous across the visible flank and neck surfaces.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The dorsal ridge profile displays a continuous, jagged 1D contour. The mane exhibits a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated edge against the background pixels.
